---
id: RNF-11
title: Distribution
priority: high
milestone: H2
status: specified
---

**Distribution.** Each version is published in GitHub Releases with a Windows installer and checksums, generated by CI (unsigned, ADR-032).

Measurable acceptance: pushing a tag `vX.Y.Z` that names the version held by every manifest (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`), on a commit of `main`, makes `release.yml` create a **draft** GitHub release `vX.Y.Z` with exactly three assets: the NSIS installer `FakeFlac_X.Y.Z_x64-setup.exe`, the MSI `FakeFlac_X.Y.Z_x64_en-US.msi` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` (one `<lowercase SHA-256>  <name>` line per installer, LF endings). Both installers carry a build-provenance attestation. The notes say that the installers are not signed, give the SmartScreen steps and how to check a download, and are followed by GitHub's generated list of merged PRs (the changelog, ADR-0029). The human publishes the draft. A tag that is malformed, a pre-release (`v1.0.0-beta.1`), does not match the manifests or is not on `main` fails in the first job (`verify`), before packaging. The logic lives in `scripts/release.mjs` behind `just` recipes and is tested by `node --test` (acceptance R1–R3, R5–R10), with every message of the script fixed in the spec. Agents cannot push a release tag or create a release (`guard-bash`, R10). Installing, SmartScreen, checking a download by hand, uninstalling and publishing are manual checks M1 and M3–M7.

Source: docs/planning/fakeflac-phases-1-3.es.md (sections 2.4, 3.11.11 e) and 3.14.3). Spec: `specs/contracts/release.md` (release version, manifests and how the version is located, `scripts/release.mjs` arguments and messages, commands `version`, `release-check`, `assets`, `draft` and `set-version`, `SHA256SUMS.txt` format, release notes text, recipes, workflow wiring, release procedure, acceptance R1–R10, manual checks M1–M7, G1 questions Q1–Q14, decided defaults D1–D9). Scenarios: `specs/features/release.feature` (tag `@RNF-11`). Decisions: ADR-0028, ADR-0029, ADR-0032, ADR-0045 (proposed). Installer size: RNF-06.
